{{RV|type=command

|version2= 0.50

|descr= Returns movement borders for HUD

|s1= [[HUDMovementLevels]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [minSpeed, maxSpeed, minAlt, maxAlt, minDir, maxDir, positionOrTarget]
* minSpeed: [[Number]] - in m/s
* maxSpeed: [[Number]] - in m/s
* minAlt: [[Number]] - in meters
* maxAlt: [[Number]] - in meters
* minDir: [[Number]] - in degrees
* maxDir: [[Number]] - in degrees
* positionOrTarget: [[Position]], [[Object]]

|x1= <sqf>HUDMovementLevels; // returns e.g [0,0,0,0,0,0,[0,0,0]]</sqf>

|seealso= [[setHUDMovementLevels]]
